Generates a random sample from an estimated lifetime distribution

ralife.Rd

Draws n random lifetimes from the distribution estimated by estimate_hazard(), calc_cdf(), or calc_cif(). For competing risks, each draw also has an event type.

Usage

ralife(n, x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'acdf'
ralife(n, x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'acdf_multi'
ralife(n, x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'acif'
ralife(n, x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'alife'
ralife(n, x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'alife_multi'
ralife(n, x, ...)

# Default S3 method
ralife(n, x, ...)

Arguments

n

number of samples.

x

an object of class alife, alife_multi, acdf, acdf_multi, or acif. Typically the output of estimate_hazard(), calc_cdf(), or calc_cif().

...

not used.

Value

For alife and acdf objects, a vector of n sampled "times to event". For alife_multi, acdf_multi, and acif objects, a data.frame with n rows and the columns event_type and lifetime ("time to event").

See also

estimate_hazard(), calc_cdf(), calc_cif()

Author

lcgodoy

Examples

aart_hazard <- estimate_hazard(lifetime = aart$Xi,
                               trunc_time = aart$Yi,
                               carry_hazard = TRUE)
set.seed(1)
ralife(n = 10, x = aart_hazard)
#>  [1] 19 25 36 40 15 40 40 39 38  8
ralife(n = 10, x = calc_cdf(aart_hazard))
#>  [1] 16 14 39 26 39 33 39 40 26 39
